name: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Comprehensive knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques. Contributors acknowledged by name or organization in the x_mitre_contributors field of each technique object in the STIX data.

peerReview.processDescription: Contributors acknowledged by name or organization in the x_mitre_contributors field of each technique object in the STIX data. Organizations credited for specific techniques. Individual researchers named for threat intelligence contributions.
